As a Host developer, I want GLM to have its own Provider identity, so that routing and attribution identify the actual service operator.; R01
As a Host developer, I want GLM Responses through the existing Client, so that I can retain my current Responses integration.; R01,R04
As a Host developer, I want GLM Chat Completions through the existing Client, so that I can reuse my Chat integration.; R01,R04
As a Host developer, I want GLM Messages through the existing Client, so that I can reuse my Messages integration.; R01,R04
As a Host developer, I want Stream and Complete on every GLM route, so that delivery style does not change the supported operation.; R04
As a Host developer, I want the simple entries on every GLM route, so that protocol-neutral calls remain available.; R04
As a Host developer, I want existing protocol-specific options retained, so that adopting GLM does not require another request API.; R04
As a Host developer, I want incorrect protocol options rejected, so that switching a Binding cannot reinterpret options silently.; R04
As a tenant administrator, I want separate Bindings for each protocol, so that each route has explicit authorization.; R02
As a tenant administrator, I want model allowlists checked before credentials are read, so that denied calls do not access secrets.; R02
As a tenant administrator, I want shared Clients to isolate tenant accounts, so that concurrent requests cannot mix credentials or state.; R16
As a Host operator, I want a fixed credential and configuration snapshot per Logical Call, so that retries retain one authorized identity.; R02,R18
As a Host operator, I want standard Key examples, so that initial deployment has an explicit billing purpose.; R03
As a Host operator, I want Key categories distinguished from endpoints, so that URL changes do not imply a different quota source.; R03
As a Host developer, I want independent model entries per protocol, so that one protocol's settings cannot alter another's behavior.; R06
As a Host developer, I want text-only model capabilities described accurately, so that an image container in the protocol is not mistaken for model vision support.; R06
As a Host developer, I want GLM-5.3's mandatory thinking respected, so that omitted options cannot produce an invalid disabled request.; R07
As a Host developer, I want GLM-5.2's thinking behavior configured independently, so that older model mappings are not applied to GLM-5.3.; R07
As a Host developer, I want canonical levels separated from wire effort, so that sampling and model capability remain understandable.; R07
As a Host developer, I want full and simple reasoning behavior documented, so that unsupported levels have predictable outcomes.; R07
As a Host developer, I want reasoning deltas and final thinking retained, so that available model output is not silently lost.; R07,R09,R12,R14
As a Host developer, I want Responses object and array content decoded correctly, so that valid final text and reasoning remain complete.; R09
As a Host developer, I want authoritative final content to reconcile streamed deltas, so that the Result reflects the completed response.; R09
As a Host developer, I want the original native reasoning preserved separately, so that parsing normalization cannot corrupt replay.; R09
As a Host developer, I want complete Responses history replay, so that I do not depend on provider-side saved sessions.; R08,R09
As a Host developer, I want function tools on all three protocols, so that the Host can continue its existing tool loop.; R11,R14
As a Host developer, I want tool argument deltas where supported, so that streaming tools expose progress before completion.; R11,R14
As a Host developer, I want tool calls and results paired across turns, so that tool round trips retain their meaning.; R11,R14
As a Host developer, I want interleaved Chat reasoning returned with tool results, so that the next generation has its required context.; R12
As a Host developer, I want unsupported tool choices rejected before sending, so that a requested constraint cannot be silently weakened.; R11,R14
As a Host developer, I want Messages thinking and signatures handled using GLM evidence, so that Claude-specific assumptions do not corrupt my history.; R13,R14
As a tenant administrator, I want persisted native state restored only through Host trust, so that client-supplied signatures do not grant replay authority.; R16
As a tenant administrator, I want cross-account native state downgraded using existing rules, so that state cannot cross an unauthorized boundary.; R16
As a Host developer, I want supported prompt cache hints isolated by tenant and account, so that raw session identifiers are not shared with the provider.; R10
As a Host developer, I want cache retention promises kept explicit, so that a routing key does not imply a guaranteed lifetime or cache hit.; R10
As a Host developer, I want usage omissions distinguished from reported zero, so that missing metadata is not represented as free usage.; R17
As a Host developer, I want reasoning tokens counted within output, so that estimates do not double count reasoning.; R17
As a Host operator, I want prices expressed in the existing dollar contract, so that RMB prices cannot be misinterpreted as dollar rates.; R17
As a Host operator, I want price snapshots attributable to sources and dates, so that estimates can be reproduced.; R17
As a Host developer, I want trusted callbacks on GLM routes, so that my existing request customization still works.; R15
As a tenant administrator, I want the final callback payload revalidated, so that callbacks cannot bypass routing, state or model constraints.; R15
As a Host developer, I want immutable request snapshots, so that later changes to my maps do not affect an active call.; R15
As a Host operator, I want explicit bounded initial retries, so that transient failures can be handled without hidden duplicate requests.; R18
As a Host operator, I want quota exhaustion distinguished from transient throttling, so that HTTP 429 does not cause pointless retries.; R18
As a Host operator, I want no replay after streaming starts, so that a partial response is not regenerated or charged twice by the library.; R18,R19
As a Host developer, I want cancellation and deadlines to produce one terminal result, so that my application can finish calls reliably.; R19
As a Host operator, I want byte, queue and concurrency limits retained, so that GLM cannot bypass resource controls.; R19
As a Host developer, I want premature EOF and malformed streams reported as errors, so that incomplete output cannot appear successful.; R09,R14,R19
As a Host developer, I want provider stop reasons and request IDs preserved when available, so that failures remain diagnosable.; R18
As a tenant administrator, I want metadata-only observation and redacted artifacts, so that operations do not leak keys, prompts or reasoning.; R19
As a maintainer, I want one public Client E2E seam, so that tests verify caller-visible behavior across all three adapters.; R04,R21
As a maintainer, I want failure scenarios written before implementation, so that the implementation is driven by observable contracts.; R21
As a maintainer, I want replayable wire and result artifacts, so that acceptance can be verified repeatedly without paid calls.; R21
As a maintainer, I want each GLM protocol tested against its own official API, so that shared adapter success cannot substitute for GLM evidence.; R13,R21
As a maintainer, I want model-specific live results, so that one model's success does not certify the other model.; R21
As a maintainer, I want documented unknowns resolved by bounded probes, so that absent documentation is not mistaken for unsupported functionality.; R13,R21
As a maintainer, I want scoped pi differential or extension records, so that the compatibility claim reflects the actual frozen route.; R20
As a maintainer, I want existing providers covered by regression checks, so that capability refactoring cannot break DeepSeek or native providers.; R05,R20
As a maintainer, I want current support-matrix and release-gate evidence, so that incomplete routes cannot be published as supported.; R21
As a Host operator, I want a reversible release, so that I can disable GLM without changing accounts or rerouting calls automatically.; R22
As a Host developer, I want complete Host configuration examples, so that local and cloud deployments use the same module contract.; R04,R22
As a maintainer, I want architecture decisions and evidence limits recorded, so that future changes preserve the reasons for the design.; R22
